text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Daaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Is she truly the strongest of her 
generation?! Vodkaa!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaaaaahhh...!)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: *gasp*... *wheeze*... *pant*!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Phew... haaah. ...Haaaah... couldn't 
match up. ...Still.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Uwoooooh!! That was amazing, so super 
hype!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Chan-chan, that was so close! Seeing you 
run is seriously thrilling though!

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Mm-hmm, I'm so glad I came to watch~! 
Great job, Ma-chan! Thank you so much~!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: ...Nnngh!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hell yeahhhh!!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"...Not yet...! I won't give up. I refuse 
to break here!"

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
"Next time, I swear next time I'm going to 
win!"

—Having moved the hearts of so many, the 
Oka Sho came to a close.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While waiting for Aston Machan to get 
ready to head home, an email suddenly 
arrived.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the screen, it was a 
notification saying her blog views had 
spiked sharply today—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Perhaps it's the "power of the Oka Sho"?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
That is good. You were able to leave a 
mark.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...I am relieved.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: I'm going over to say hello.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Is she going to talk with the other 
runners? Seeing her leave before I could 
hear a reply, I decided to wait a little 
longer.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(...Even with my eyes closed, I can still 
hear it.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
(...A wonderful sound, a wonderful sight. 
I lost, but it was a great race.)

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Yeah, excellent, perfectly on track.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
...Everyone. Please be sure to put it away 
properly.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Please take good care of it, okay?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: ...This is as far as Machan goes.
